provenance: Original synthetic teaching data for v04-c05, created 2026-10-07. No observed households, firms or estimated population effects. Reuse and modification for teaching with attribution to the Economics & Finance Mastery Library are permitted.

income.unit: thousand USD per household per year
income.quantiles: Median averages the two central observations for even n; quartiles are medians of the lower and upper halves, excluding the central observation for odd n.

revenue.unit: nominal USD per year; common currency, no inflation adjustment

scatter.grain: one synthetic worker per row; groups are recorded starting-condition categories, not randomized treatments

uncertainty.model: Independent normally distributed unbiased mean estimators with known standard errors; illustrative 1.96 critical value, approximately 95% marginal coverage
